newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,104 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,104 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,104 contracts compared with 2,614 overnight Monday.
There were 128 wheat, 285 corn, 617 soybean, nine soymeal, 45 soyoil, five oat, 10 wheat calls, two corn calls, one soybean call and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 2-1/4 to 4-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1/4 cent lower to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were one to 3-1/4 cents higher.
